details.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is DeepSeek's multimodal mixture-of-experts chat model, released September 10, 2026, reached on Fireworks AI via the model id deepseek-v4p1-flash. Its Hugging Face model card describes a Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture with 552 billion backbone parameters that activates only 8 billion for input processing and 16 billion for output generation, with a native DeepSeek-ViT vision encoder so it processes images and text together from pretraining rather than through a later add-on. DeepSeek's launch announcement states new pre-training methods and larger-scale reinforcement-learning post-training give it benchmark results ahead of the larger DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and that it replaces the retired DeepSeek-V4-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp models, which now route to it for compatibility.
advantages: Scores 90.9 on GPQA Diamond, a graduate-level science reasoning benchmark, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Passes 90.6% of tasks on Terminal-Bench 2.1, an agentic terminal-use benchmark.
Resolves 74.2% of tasks on DeepSWE v1.1, a software-engineering agent benchmark.
Resolves 88.1% of tasks on CyberGym, a cybersecurity-research agent benchmark.
Natively processes images and text through a built-in DeepSeek-ViT vision encoder from pretraining, rather than a later-added adapter.
DeepSeek reports its new pre-training and larger-scale RL post-training give benchmark results ahead of the larger DeepSeek-V4-Pro model.
disadvantages: No audio input or output; per DeepSeek's own materials and the catalog's recorded modality, capability is limited to text and images.
use_cases: Agentic coding and terminal/command-line automation, with documented integration into tools such as Codex.
Software-engineering agents that resolve repository bug-fixing tasks (DeepSWE v1.1).
Visual-understanding tasks that combine images with tool use.
Long-context agentic workflows using up to a 1,000,000-token context window.
General chat and reasoning tasks (GPQA Diamond, Humanity's Last Exam).

notes: Confirmed on Fireworks AI's own model listing that the id deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4p1-flash is displayed as 'DeepSeek V4.1 Flash' with a 1,048,576-token context window and vision support, matching this target's catalog facts (max_input_tokens 1,048,576; modality image+text) and the same underlying model already covered under the sibling slug deepseek-flash (a different id spelling for the same DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash release). A Codeforces rating (3471) and 'Agent's Last Exam' (31.8, a different benchmark from Humanity's Last Exam) were left out of evaluations: the former is not a 0-100 accuracy score, the latter was left out for brevity in favor of the more established Humanity's Last Exam figure. No language list is published by DeepSeek for this model.
